title: 12 Best Natural Wine Bars in Cartagena
description: Explore Cartagena's top natural wine bars for unique biodynamic and organic selections. Discover hidden gems and popular spots for sustainable sips in 2026.

places.name: Celele
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask your sommelier for a natural wine pairing with their multi-course tasting menu, especially a crisp skin-contact white.

places.name: Carmen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pair a medium-bodied natural red from Chile or Argentina with their famous Lomo de Res.

places.name: Demente
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A crisp Pet-Nat (Pétillant Naturel) or an orange wine to go with their grilled octopus or patatas bravas.

places.name: El Boliche Cebichería
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of chilled natural Vermentino or Albariño with the "Ceviche Mixto."

places.name: Alquímico
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Inquire about their "Wine of the Moment" which often highlights a unique natural or biodynamic bottle, paired with their elevated bar snacks.

places.name: Alma Restaurante & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A crisp, mineral-driven natural white from an Old World producer to accompany their signature seafood dishes.

places.name: La Vitrola
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Consult with your server for an off-menu recommendation, perhaps a robust natural Garnacha to complement the hearty traditional dishes and the lively music.

places.name: Cafe del Mar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A light, refreshing natural rosé or a chilled red to enjoy the spectacular sunset.

places.name: Interno Restaurante
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask about their special natural wine selections that support sustainable producers, perhaps a bold red to pair with their regional meat dishes.

places.name: Malagana Café & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A chilled natural Cava or a light-bodied natural red from Spain or Portugal to complement their creative small plates.

places.name: Mistura Restaurante
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their white or orange natural wines, which pair exceptionally well with the vibrant ceviches and sushi rolls.

places.name: El Santísimo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A rich, earthy natural Pinot Noir or Cabernet Franc to pair with their slow-cooked meats or a refined fish dish.
